serviceControlDesc: Restart the service, or rebuild the frontend and restart
restartConfirm: Restart the service? It will be briefly unavailable.
buildRestartConfirm: Rebuild the frontend and restart? The service stays up during the build and restarts automatically once it succeeds.
restartingHint: Restarting, the page will reload once the service is back…
buildingHint: Building frontend, will restart automatically when done…
buildInProgress: A build is already in progress
projectUpdateDesc: Pull the latest code from the remote repository, optionally building and restarting in one step
pullConfirm: Pull the latest code from the remote repository?
updateRestartConfirm: Pull the latest code, rebuild the frontend and restart? It will not restart on pull conflicts or build failures.
conflictHint: Update hit conflicts, please resolve them manually
dirtyHint: Uncommitted changes in the workspace, please commit or stash first
crashInfoDesc: The start script supervisor auto-restarts the process after a crash and records the crash state
crashAutoRestartHint: On fatal exits (e.g. segfaults) the supervisor restarts automatically with growing backoff; after 5 consecutive crashes it stops and needs manual inspection.
